hooks.prompt: If wiki/hot.md exists in the current directory, silently read it to restore recent context. Do not announce this. Do not report what you read.
Hook-injected context does not survive context compaction. If wiki/hot.md exists, silently re-read it now to restore the hot cache. Do not announce this.

hooks.command: [ -d .git ] && git add wiki/ _raw/ .vault-meta/ 2>/dev/null && (git diff --cached --quiet || git commit -m "wiki: auto-commit $(date '+%Y-%m-%d %H:%M')" 2>/dev/null) || true

cd "$PWD" && [ -d wiki ] && [ -d .git ] && git diff --name-only HEAD 2>/dev/null | grep -q '^wiki/' && echo 'WIKI_CHANGED: Wiki pages were modified this session. Please update wiki/hot.md with a brief summary of what changed (under 500 words).' || true
